Get Risk Definition

Source: R/get_risk_analysis.R
get_risk_definition.Rd

Load risk definition config from options, JSON file, or fallback to bundled file.

Usage

get_risk_definition()

Value

A list of risk configuration items.

Examples

risk_rule <- get_risk_definition()
#> Using package's default risk definition.
print(risk_rule)
